dct_description_sm:
A Water Source is a point feature that identifies a source of water, whether potable or non-potable.

Identified in this data class:
  • Spring Water Source: A Spring Water Source is a source of spring water whether potable or non-potable.
  • Water Intake: A site on a water body from which a water supply is drawn.
Legislated or Legal Authority for Collection: None
